source:
state x = 40
state radius = 12
input move = KeyM
input shrink = KeyS
box moving(x, 100, 30, 30, "#7ed9ae")
text label(20, 40, x, "x: ")
circle bubble(500, 150, radius, "#c9f08b")
box static0(20, 200, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static1(90, 200, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static2(160, 200, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static3(230, 200, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static4(300, 200, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static5(370, 200, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static6(440, 200, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static7(20, 240, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static8(90, 240, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static9(160, 240, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static10(230, 240, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static11(300, 240, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static12(370, 240, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static13(440, 240, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static14(20, 280, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static15(90, 280, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static16(160, 280, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static17(230, 280, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static18(300, 280, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static19(370, 280, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
box static20(440, 280, 20, 20, "#8da5bb")
on move.down { x = x + 0.25 }
on shrink.down { radius = radius - 24 }
timingScope: 100 synchronous synthetic keyboard taps after 20 warm-up taps; JS dispatch to DOM submission only, including instrumentation; not paint/input latency.
setup: Archived app/runtime are supplied by test-only routing; snapshot calls and element creation are instrumented. Same Wasm/compiler and production configuration.
